Owner controls

Revoke an agent or return its USDC to your MetaMask address. This page uses MetaMask directly; the Decision402 backend is not needed. Base Sepolia only.

These actions require the wallet owner's MetaMask account and test ETH for gas. Revocation takes effect once mined; it cannot undo a completed payment.

Keep this file and your contract address. If MetaMask is unavailable for a local file, serve it on localhost. Do not enter private keys here.
